svg.title: SDK lifecycle
svg.desc: starting, then ready (sdk.ready, once a page) when the campaign is in: at once from a copy this browser saved in the last 10 minutes, else when the API answers. If the API fails and there is no saved copy, the SDK stops at failed (sdk.error, action campaign.load) without sdk.ready; with a copy it stays ready and still sends that sdk.error. Both set html data-next-error="campaign". Once ready, a step that fails sends sdk.error and the SDK stays ready.

g.text: a saved copy, or the API answers

path.style: fill: none; stroke: var(--clean-fg-muted, #6b7280); stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 5 4

text.style: fill: var(--clean-accent, #2563eb); font-size: 12px; font-family: var(--clean-font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace)
fill: var(--clean-accent, #2563eb); font-size: 12px; font-family: var(--clean-font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace)

text.tspan: A copy saved in this browser in the last 10 minutes makes it ready at once; an API failure then sends sdk.error
Once ready, a failed step sends sdk.error and the SDK stays ready
sdk.error is not replayed to late listeners: read html[data-next-error]

tspan.style: fill: var(--color-rose-500, #e11d48); font-family: var(--clean-font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace)

text.tspan: → failed without a saved copy, else stays ready · data-next-error="campaign"

tspan.style: fill: var(--color-rose-500, #e11d48); font-family: var(--clean-font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace)

text.tspan: → works on without saving across pages
